name: team_planning_redo_change
description: Redo a change, pin or clear that was undone in a scenario of a Team Planning plan, in its place. Give event_id, as team_planning_history lists it, or leave it out to redo what your own latest undo in the scenario took back. In a plan scoped to chosen units, a change about someone it no longer covers is refused unless it places them in one of its units. Refused when a change to the same subject and facet was made since (the refusal names it), when it isn't undone, or unless the caller is an editor.
